findings.title: Lambda permission grants invoke to everyone
findings.description: A Lambda resource policy with principal "*" lets any AWS principal invoke the function. Scope the principal to the intended service or account.

evidence.expected: a specific service or account principal

findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
